summary: No formal marker for the target cell type (L4:Type D enteroendocrine / pancreatic delta cell) was found in the paper Markdown. The existing candidates INS and GCG are formal markers for b-cells and a-cells, respectively, but these cell types are outside the target scope and are therefore excluded.

markers.source_context: Expression of cell-typical (INS for b-cells, GCG for a-cells) and non-typical hormone in cells, ranked by transcriptional noise. Cell identity is indicated by marker gene expression.

issues.description: Existing candidates INS and GCG are formal markers but for b-cells and a-cells, not for the target D enteroendocrine/delta cells; they should be excluded from the target marker table.

The paper mentions d-cells (delta cells) as a major endocrine cell type but does not provide a specific gene used as a marker for them in the available Markdown; no formal target marker could be extracted.
